event.text: Go to an emergency department now — do not wait. Sudden, painless loss of vision in one eye that has not returned can be caused by a blocked retinal artery, which is treated like a stroke and is time-critical. Have someone drive you or call 911 rather than driving yourself. If you develop face, arm or leg weakness or trouble speaking, call 911 immediately.
